prompt.intro: I want to brainstorm a game based on the following starting points.
prompt.sparring: Help me develop this game idea.
prompt.noGdd: Don't write the game or a long game design document yet.
prompt.techIntro: The game is meant to be built with: {tech}.
prompt.techWeb: Keep the idea feasible in a browser: a reasonable scope, light graphics and a tight core loop that works without a big production.
prompt.techEngine: Consider the engine's strengths and limitations, and suggest a scope that a small team or a solo developer can actually build.
prompt.techOther: Consider the strengths and limitations of this technology, and keep the scope realistic.
prompt.noCode: Don't write any code yet, though.
prompt.steps: summarizing what is interesting about this combination
identifying which of the randomly rolled elements fit well together and which don't
asking a few good questions that would help refine the idea
if needed, suggesting one or two changes that would make the idea more interesting
prompt.goal: The goal is to find a genuinely playable concept, not to force in every generated element.
jam.heading: Game jam constraints
jam.theme: Theme — choose or write your own
jam.themePlaceholder: Choose from 300 themes or write your own
jam.hint: Small scope, flexible value counts. Retained choices outside the suggested scope are marked on their cards.
jam.warning: Outside the suggested jam scope. Consider simplifying or rolling this field.
jam.promptScope: Keep one main goal, one core mechanic and a small playable space. Interpret ambitious setting or story elements through simple assets rather than large simulations. Avoid online infrastructure and elaborate secondary systems.
jam.promptInterpret: Make the jam theme affect what the player actually does. Suggest two possible interpretations and choose one; a theme is not just a title or backstory.
jam.promptBuild: Define the smallest playable version with at most three essential features, then separate optional stretch goals. Give a rough time plan suitable for the selected time, team and experience.
jam.promptWarning: If a retained choice conflicts with the jam scope, explain how to simplify it. Do not promise that every combination can be completed within the time limit.
jam.promptCounts: Respect the selected number of values in each category. A single core loop is a scope suggestion, not a limit on the user's selections.
